items.title: The High Roller
items.description: A private back room. A figure in shadow slides a towering stack of chips across green felt and gestures at the empty chair. "One hand. Your nerve against my money." You can't see their eyes, only the gold card in the center of the table.

choices.label: Take the bet
choices.outcome: You sit. The hand is brutal. They read your bluff, and their ring catches your knuckles as you both grab the pot. But you walk out heavier than you walked in, and that's what counts.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.outcome: You tip your hat and keep walking. Behind you, the shadow chuckles, but some games aren't worth the ante.

items.title: The Broken Machine
items.description: A service corridor. One slot machine hangs open, sparking, its guts glowing with a jammed jackpot no one has claimed. A red toolbox sits abandoned beside it.

choices.label: Reach in and grab it
choices.outcome: The machine bites. A live wire kisses your wrist, and the whole corridor smells like burnt hair. But your pockets jingle all the way to the next room.

choices.label: Repair it properly
choices.outcome: Twenty patient minutes with the toolbox. The machine purrs back to life and spits one strange, gleaming token into your palm: a thank-you from the house's oldest resident.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.outcome: You've seen what this casino does to greedy hands. The sparks fade behind you.

items.title: The Lounge Singer
items.description: In the smoky lounge, a singer in an emerald gown holds the room still with one long note. For a moment, the casino's cruelty feels very far away.

choices.label: Tip generously
choices.outcome: She catches the coins without missing a note, and sings the next verse straight to you. Something in your chest unknots, and you feel tougher than you've felt in years.

choices.label: Just listen
choices.outcome: You lean on the bar and let the song wash the ache out of your bones. When it ends, you're breathing easier.

items.title: Dice in the Alley
items.description: Behind the casino, three hustlers crouch around glowing dice on a crate under a flickering neon spade. They look up. "Room for one more, if your coin's good."

choices.label: Play a few rounds
choices.outcome: The dice love you tonight. The hustlers love you less. A farewell shove into the wall says so, but you leave with their coin.

choices.label: Snatch the pot and run
choices.outcome: You're fast, but not untouchable. A bottle catches your shoulder as you vault the fence. Worth it. The pot sings in your pocket.

choices.label: Not your game
choices.outcome: You flip them a single chip for the show and keep moving. Their laughter follows you, easy and harmless.

items.title: The Security Office
items.description: A door left ajar: a wall of monitors, confiscated lucky charms in a glass case, and on one screen, your own face circled in gold ink. Somebody upstairs is watching you.

choices.label: Break into the case
choices.summary: Gain a random relic, lose 10 HP
choices.outcome: The case shatters louder than you'd like. You grab the nearest charm and dive out the window one heartbeat before the guards burst in, collecting bruises and a prize.

choices.label: Slip away quietly
choices.summary: Gain 10-20 coins from a dropped wallet
choices.outcome: You melt back into the corridor, pausing only to liberate a wallet somebody dropped in their hurry. Let them watch. You'll give them a show soon enough.
